Name: Spooky's Soot Sprites
Author: ACatNamedSpooky
Description:
[size=4]Main File:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4][size=4]Replaces the dust spirits and the dangerous dust spirits in game via[/size] [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size].[/size]
[/list][size=4]Optional Files:[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=4]Replaces the dust spirits and the dangerous dust spirits in game via .xnb files.[/size]
[*][size=4]Adds a Soot Sprite monster pet available for purchase at Marnie's Shop via [size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size].[/size]
[/list][size=4]
Requirements:
[/size][list=1]
[list=1]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 2.0.5+ (for the soot sprite pet AND the main file sprite replacement)[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ 4.0+ [size=4](for the soot sprite pet AND the main file sprite replacement)[/size][/size]
[*][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ [/b](not required but highly recommended)[/size]
[/list][/list]
[size=4]Instructions:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]xnb version instructions are inside the zip folders for each monster[/size]
[*][size=4]CP versions for both main and optional files require you to download the above required mods as well as unzipping and dropping each mod into your Stardew mods folder ([url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]Full guide on how to install mods[/url]﻿)[/size]
[/list]



[b][u][center][size=3]Do not hesitate to reach out to me either in posts or privately in messages if you have any questions or concerns~ :)[/size][/center]
[/u]
[/b]
